pages.title: Long Tables
pages.text: These dining tables come in every wood type. Place matching tables side by side to build a larger table, or line them up on opposite sides to create a long banquet surface without gaps. The low tea table, cut from a dark oak log, fills a two-by-two area instead.

Give your table some color by right-clicking it with a carpet or tatami. The material becomes a tablecloth and can be removed with shears. Breaking a decorated table drops both the table and its cloth.
